definitionsEn: dat. & obj. The pronoun of the second person, in the nominative,
dative, and objective case, indicating the person or persons addressed.
See the Note under Ye.

example.en: I thought you liked to learn new things.
example.zh: 我以為你喜歡學習新事物。

definitionsEn: n. a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days
n. a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity
n. the period of time that it takes for a planet (as, e.g., Earth or Mars) to make a complete revolution around the sun
definitionsZh: n. 年, 年度, 年龄

example.en: I had an operation for glaucoma last year.
example.zh: 我去年動了青光眼手術。

definitionsEn: n. an affirmative
Used to show agreement or acceptance.
Used to indicate disagreement or dissent in reply to a negative statement.

phrases.translationZh: 应声虫, 随声附和的人

example.en: Yes, he's almost as tall as I am.
example.zh: 是的，他幾乎和我一樣高。

definitionsEn: n. any immature animal
n. United States film and television actress (1913-2000)
n. United States civil rights leader (1921-1971)
definitionsZh: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的
n. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽

example.en: The job is not suitable for young girls.
example.zh: 这个岗位不合适小姑娘。

definitionsEn: r. up to the present time
r. within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time
Nevertheless; however; but; despite that.
definitionsZh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而

phrases.translationZh: 一项光荣而艰巨的任务

example.en: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?

definitionsEn: n. the day immediately before today
n. the recent past
r. on the day preceding today

phrases.translationZh: 最近的事, 最近的东西

example.en: You didn't come to school yesterday, did you?
example.zh: 你昨天沒來學校, 是嗎?

definitionsEn: pron. An emphasized or reflexive form of the pronoun of the
second person; -- used as a subject commonly with you
as, you yourself

example.en: You are now old enough to support yourself.
example.zh: 你已經到了可以自給自足的年紀了。

definitionsEn: r not only so, but
Yes.
Used to express acknowledgment of what was previously said.

example.en: Then, let's go and eat, yeah?

definitionsEn: n. the time of life between childhood and maturity
n. early maturity
the state of being young or immature or inexperienced
definitionsZh: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春
[法] 青年, 青年时期, 青春时期

phrases.translationZh: [法] 青年的纵欲行为, 放荡青年

example.en: In her youth, my mother was very beautiful.
example.zh: 我母親年輕的時候十分漂亮。

definitionsEn: n. a unit of length equal to 3 feet
defined as 91.44 centimeters
originally taken to be the average length of a stride
definitionsZh: n. 码, 庭院, 工场

phrases.translationZh: 放置牲畜的仓前空场, 车站旁的牲畜栏

example.en: I planted a peach tree in my yard.
example.zh: 我在我的院子里种了棵桃树。

definitionsEn: n. an amount of a product
v. be the cause or source of
v. give in, as to influence or pressure
definitionsZh: n. 生产量, 投资收益
vt. 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服
vi. 出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌

phrases.translationZh: [经] 税后收益(付税后收益)率

example.en: A 6% yield is guaranteed on the investment.
example.zh: 這投資保證有 6% 的回報。

definitionsEn: n. yellow color or pigment
the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons
v. turn yellow

phrases.translationZh: 杂种狗;卑鄙的家伙;胆小鬼
以受雇工人不加入工会为条件的雇用契约

example.en: His teeth are yellow from smoking too much.
